gaps.category: Taxi and ride-hire operators: taxi traffic permit (taxitrafiktillstånd), taxameter, and the new taxi-law rules
gaps.first_search: taxitrafiktillstånd nya regler 2026 taxiförare enskild firma Transportstyrelsen taxameter kontrollenhet
gaps.why: Category 18 covered only light-van tachographs. Sweden has many sole-trader taxi firms. They hold a Transportstyrelsen permit, depend on the yrkestrafikregister, and must use a certified taxameter and control unit. Taxi law was tightened after the 2024-2025 inquiries. This is a distinct buyer group from the light-van hauliers already in the ledger.

gaps.category: Alcohol serving licences (serveringstillstånd) and egenkontroll for small restaurants and bars
gaps.first_search: serveringstillstånd årlig redovisning alkoholomsättning kommun tillsynsavgift egenkontroll alkohollagen småföretag
gaps.why: Municipal alcohol licences carry the duty to file annual alcohol turnover statements (alkoholförsäljning) with the municipality for the licence fee, plus egenkontroll under alkohollagen. Restaurants and cafes are among Sweden's most numerous small operators. Category 34 covers only personalliggare, and the farm-gate alcohol idea in known (K22) is a different buyer group.

gaps.category: Reindeer herding, sami villages and small forestry/hunting/fishing operators (rennäring, jakt, fiske)
gaps.first_search: renskötsel rapportering Sametinget Länsstyrelsen renlängd slakt rovdjursersättning samebyar administration
gaps.why: Category 6 and 7 covered livestock transport and slaughter, but not reindeer herders. Samebyar and herders must keep records and report to Länsstyrelsen and Sametinget. Reindeer slaughter and predator-compensation reporting add duties. Reindeer herding is a Sweden-specific sector with many family firms. Related checks: fishing-licence and catch reporting by small commercial fishers and fish farmers (K17 only covers the logbook).

gaps.category: Food business registration and egenkontroll for small food operators and food-contact importers (livsmedelsföretag) including the new Livsmedelsverket e-registration
gaps.first_search: livsmedelsföretag registrering kommun årlig kontrollavgift egenkontroll HACCP småföretag nya regler 2026 livsmedelskontroll
gaps.why: Category 20 lists farm-shop and food-producer egenkontroll only as a weak idea. Sweden has tens of thousands of registered food businesses (cafes, kiosks, pizzerias, food trucks). They register with the municipality, pay annual control fees, and face the 2024-2026 changes to food-control fees and the allergen and origin rules. The pass did not check the municipal annual-fee and registration duties directly.

gaps.category: Beekeepers, apiary registration and other small animal-keeper registers (Jordbruksverket) -- category 8 was not_reached
gaps.first_search: biodlare registrering bigård Jordbruksverket anmälan bisjukdomar lagen om provtagning på djur djurhållare register
gaps.why: The one search returned nothing, so the register duty was never confirmed. Sweden has a registration duty for animal keepers (djurhållare) with Jordbruksverket and a national bee-disease control (bisjukdomar, biodlare, bigårdsregistrering). Sheep and goat, horse (hästregister) and poultry keepers must also register their holdings and report movements. This needs to be run again with Swedish terms.

gaps.category: Taxi, transport, delivery and platform couriers: food-delivery and cargo-bike sole traders, plus mandatory F-skatt and platform reporting for gig workers
gaps.first_search: plattformsarbete direktiv genomförande Sverige utredning 2026 budbolag skatteverket kontroll F-skatt kurir
gaps.why: The 2024-2026 coverage of platform and gig work is thin. DAC7 was noted but only as a platform duty. A gig-courier sole trader has to keep a tax record and meet F-skatt and VAT duties, and Skatteverket has run control actions on the restaurant and delivery sectors. The EU Platform Work Directive must be implemented by December 2026 and Sweden has an inquiry underway. A research pass should check the national bill and what duty falls on the small operator.

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: Private employers use Skatteverket's simplified employer declaration SKV 448 (monthly, due the 12th; threshold about 10,000 SEK per person per year). Low frequency, free state form, no software gap seen. Personal-assistance reporting is K11; work-permit conditions are K04.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: No new law in force. Only motions and SOU 2014:72 proposing a cash ban and permits; the issue is now with the Miljöstraffrättsutredningen (M 2022:4). Watch item only.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Dealers in listed used goods must register with the police and keep numbered chronological purchase notes (inköpsnotor) under lag 1999:271 and förordning 1999:272. The notes must be kept for 10 years, goods held one month, and goods tagged to the note. Pawnbanks fall under pantbankslagen 1995:1000 and are out of this regime. See candidate C1.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Same regime as category 3: gold, silver, platinum, gems and jewellery are on the registrable-goods list. Cash-register (kassaregister) rules also apply. See candidate C1.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: Länsstyrelsen authorises scrappers under bilskrotningsförordning 2007:186 (max 5 years). Authorised scrappers issue mottagningsbevis and skrotningsintyg to Transportstyrelsen electronically. Existing systems were not checked. Weak candidate C8.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Länsstyrelsen inspects animal transport vehicles. By-product transporters register with Jordbruksverket. No new reporting duty or 2026 rule found. Nothing new beyond K10.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Only motion 2025/26:2642 on simpler rules for small abattoirs, plus RISE guideline 2025:3 for small-scale slaughter. No enacted change. Weak candidate C10.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: One search returned nothing on apiary registration. Whether bee yards must be registered with Jordbruksverket could not be confirmed. Unverifiable.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Veterinary reporting framework re-enabled 1 Oct 2025 (prop. 2024/25:91, djurhälsodata). Horse-medicine reporting from 1 Jan 2026 (written question 2025/26:344) is K10. Nothing new beyond K10.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Drillers must send well logs to SGU's Brunnsarkiv under lag 1975:424. About 80% of new wells are reported according to a municipal source. Overlaps K05.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Municipal procurement of sludge emptying (kommunal slamtömning). A proposed sewage-sludge register at Naturvårdsverket (due 31 March) only appears in a consultation response, with small sewage plants and samfälligheter objecting; in-force status not verified. Nothing new beyond K07 and K08.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Lifts get annual inspection by an accredited body (Boverket BFS 2025:11, per a vendor, unverified). No owner register found. OVK is K16. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Under LIVSFS 2022:12, small shared waterworks need a faroanalys and undersökningsprogram approved by the municipality (valid at most 6 years), plus raw-water sampling from 2026 (per Kristianstad's template). Buyer group is samfällighetsföreningar and shared waterworks. See candidate C3 (related K06).

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Kemikalieinspektionen runs an e-portal for annual quantity reporting by product-approval holders, importers and sellers. Class 3 purchase-certificate checks were only a 2019 consultation proposal. Sprutjournal is K09. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: No licensing or register for staffing agencies in Sweden. Lag 1993:440 needs no permit, and a registration idea was only discussed in a working group. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Burial is run by Svenska kyrkan parishes (plus Stockholm and Tranås municipalities); Länsstyrelsen supervises. No funeral-director register or new rule found. Bouppteckning is K12. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Associations only register beneficial owners after giving the owner's details to a bank or other obliged entity (lag 2017:631, 4-week deadline). Dir. 2023:49 aims to widen this to all legal persons. The outcome and start date were not verified. Älgdata and Viltdata are free hunting-team reporting channels. See C6 and C9.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: From 1 Jul 2026 international transport and cabotage with 2.5-3.5 t vehicles needs a smart tachograph v2, driver and company cards, and driving and rest time rules (Transportstyrelsen). Taxi: annual taxameter inspection, April 2026 compliance report says compliance is high, no new rule found. See C2.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Money changers: FI registration required for all since 1 Jan 2024, plus annual owner and management review and suspicious-transaction reporting to the police. Small and niche. Weak candidate C7.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Tattoo and piercing studios notify the municipality 6 weeks ahead and keep egenkontroll. Driving schools need a Transportstyrelsen permit, with student register and training cards, and a Piteå permit was revoked in April 2026. Private pedagogisk omsorg needs municipal approval. E-cigarette and nicotine-product retailers notify and need an egenkontrollprogram. Farm shops register with the municipality and need egenkontroll. Älgdata and Viltdata cover hunting teams. See C4, C5, C9, C10, C11, C12.

candidates.category: 31. Private dental care providers (tandvårdslagen) permit and Försäkringskassan connection
candidates.evidence: https://regeringen.se/rattsliga-dokument/departementsserien-och-promemorior/2026/06/nya-overgangsbestammelser-med-anledning-av-tillstandsplikt-for-privata-tandvardgivare/ ; https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/dokument-och-lagar/dokument/betankande/starkt-kontroll-over-tandvardssektorn_hd01sou7/html/ ; https://tandlakarforbundet.se/app/uploads/2026/06/Sveriges-Tandlakarforbund_Remissvar-Promemoria-overgangsbestammelser-med-anledning-av-tillstandsplikt-for-privata-tandvardgivare.pdf ; https://www.forsakringskassan.se/tandvard/for-dig-inom-tandvarden/anslutning-till-det-statliga-tandvardsstod . Per the sources: IVO has decided 7 permit cases (6 refusals, 1 approval); processing takes months; the application fee is estimated at SEK 30,000; TEV wants forms adapted for small clinics.
candidates.existing: Competitor search 'tandläkare ansöka tillstånd IVO hjälp mall konsult tjänst' found no consultant, template or software offer; only IVO forms and association contacts. Not exhaustive.
candidates.name: Dental IVO Permit and Register Pack for small private dental clinics
candidates.trigger: Permit duty for private dental providers from 1 Jan 2026 (IVO). Connection to the state dental subsidy requires entry in the vårdgivarregister. Ministry memo of 8 Jun 2026 proposes: apply before 1 Jan 2027 and keep operating until the final decision; proposed in force 23 Aug 2026 (a proposal, not decided). The Försäkringskassan connection fee proposal (SEK 5,000 per clinic) is unconfirmed.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the transitional rule was adopted; real count of unregistered small clinics; IVO's e-service and forms; whether dental software vendors (e.g. Carestream/Julie-type systems) or Tandläkarförbundet offer application help; willingness to pay given a SEK 30,000 fee and a one-off, deadline-driven need; whether the IVO scrutiny is mostly about owner suitability and finances (less software-solvable).

coverage.found: Transportstyrelsen's 2025 compliance survey (published 2026) lists 8,658 permit holders. Skatteverket reports 470 taxi tax investigations since 2020, with 8 in 10 assessed higher, SEK 76m in total. Current changes: SFS 2024:1201 (permit decision content, vehicle notification) and a government assignment on price info and rest time (partial report due 30 Jun 2027). result.competitor: I found no software for Swedish inköpsnotor or for electronic reporting to the police in 6 searches, which covered Swedish phrases for inköpsnota software, begagnathandel kassasystem, guldköp systems and BankID seller ID. Results were only general purchasing tools (Pleo, SAP, ClickUp) and POS/kassaregister vendors that cover the separate cash-register duty. The police do not offer a portal for submitting notes. SOU 2014:72 calls the paper note method outdated and inefficient ('föråldrad och ineffektiv') and says nothing about electronic notes.
result.duty: The duty is in force. Lag (1999:271) requires dealers to register with the police before trading in the listed used goods (gold, silver and platinum items, mobiles, computers, cameras, bikes, mopeds, boats and others). Förordning (1999:272), consolidated through SFS 2026:434, sets the per-purchase rules. §9: special inköpsnotor numbered in chronological order, recording date, type and condition, make and serial number, agreed price, and the seller's name and address, plus personnummer and ID type if the seller is unknown to the dealer. §10: goods must be labelled with the note reference. §11: a holding period (liggetid) of at least one month under the law, which the police can waive. §12: notes kept 10 years and may not be erased. §13: the police may demand information, including systematic reporting. §3: exempt below 500 kr, or 2,000 kr for art. The obligation applies to every purchase. Police regulations RPSFS 2009:3 were repealed from the end of February 2026 (PMFS 2/2026), so the ordinance's text now governs the details. The penalty level was not checked. The ordinance does not say whether notes may be kept electronically. Pawnbroking is not covered by the registration duty.
result.market: No national count was found. SOU 2014:72 gives registered dealers per region as of December 2013: Stockholm about 850, Västra Götaland about 510, Östergötland about 430. It also says many covered dealers have never registered. A rough extrapolation from those regions suggests about 3,000 to 5,000 registered dealers nationally; this is an estimate, not a figure from a source. Most are small shops dealing in phones, gold, bikes or general second-hand goods.
result.reason: The duty is real, current (SFS 2026:434) and applies to every purchase: numbered notes, seller ID, labelling, a one-month hold and 10-year retention. No dedicated tool was found. The market is small, probably a few thousand registered dealers. Many dealers never register, and enforcement looks weak (SOU 2014:72), so willingness to pay is limited. Some shops will add a note field to their POS instead. It is unclear whether the police accept electronic notes, because the ordinance says 'särskilda numrerade inköpsnotor'. The MVP would be simple: numbered notes, ID capture, label printing, hold-period alerts and export for police requests. Gold buyers face money-laundering scrutiny, which helps the pitch. Distribution through police registration lists or trade bodies is uncertain.
